prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1097; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Baytown, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space near the entrance.

Q: What happened just before the impact?

A: I checked my mirror, didn't see anything, and started backing out slowly. Then a silver sedan came down the aisle and hit the rear passenger side of my car.

Q: How fast do you think the other vehicle was moving?

A: Not fast, maybe walking speed or a little quicker. It wasn't a big crash, but it was enough to jolt me.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the collision?

A: Not at first. I got stiff in the neck later that evening, and by the next morning I had a lot of pain and tightness in my neck and upper shoulders.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care, and they diagnosed a neck strain. They gave me a prescription for muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do gentle stretching.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Yes, I still have some stiffness when I turn my head to the left, and sitting at a desk for long periods makes it worse. I'm following up with my doctor next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was careful and I believe the other driver should have seen me backing out. I'm just hoping this gets sorted out so I can get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
